mission: Validate RoPE theta only after MODEL-246 selects the relevant ~10M training context.

prerequisite_gate.required_terminal_output: A durable repository authority selecting the relevant 10M context from the supported 256/512/1024 comparison under matched parameters and matched source-content exposure.
prerequisite_gate.reason: The mission explicitly orders MODEL-247 after MODEL-246. Running theta before that context decision would make context a moving confound and violate the experiment contract.

historical_evidence_intake.model36_finding: All then-current stage configs use full rotary RoPE at theta 10000; RoPE/KV mechanics are capability plumbing, not learned long-context evidence.
historical_evidence_intake.model197_role: Predecessor matched 10M context-transfer protocol only; it does not satisfy the explicit MODEL-246 prerequisite for this worker.

alternative_theta_search.notes: Repository PR evidence searches for theta/RoPE and plausible larger-theta mentions did not locate an executed theta-quality comparison. No 100000, 500000, 1000000, YaRN, NTK interpolation, or other candidate is invented from convention.

allowed_candidate_policy_after_unblock.alternative_requirement: Must be identified by exact prior executed repository evidence and remain scientifically live after MODEL-246 fixes context.
allowed_candidate_policy_after_unblock.if_no_admissible_alternative_exists: Do not manufacture a second arm; retain theta 10000.

frozen_variables_after_unblock: total model parameter capacity and all non-theta ModelSpec geometry
initial weight generation within each paired seed
source document ordering and source-content exposure
optimizer family, learning rate, betas, epsilon, weight decay, clipping and schedule

paired_seed_contract.rule: Each admissible theta arm must start from identical initial parameter tensors and consume the identical ordered data/loss-token trace for every seed. Seed count and promotion statistics must obey the current project decision authority; they must not be weakened for MODEL-247.

required_measurements.normal_held_out_bpb: Evaluate the same immutable held-out content at the MODEL-246-authorized horizon and report paired BPB deltas.
required_measurements.dependency_distance_strata: Report reserved dependency probes by preregistered distance strata that fit inside the selected context; do not score a distance the selected training context cannot support.
required_measurements.maximum_context_behavior: Exercise the exact selected maximum trained context, including boundary prefill/decode behavior and over-context rejection where applicable.
attention_logit_numerical_health: per-layer attention-score finite status and extrema or incumbent equivalent telemetry
required_measurements.cached_stateless_inference_parity: Compare incumbent model-native cached decode against stateless full-prefix inference on identical token sequences using the existing project parity tolerance; do not widen tolerance per theta arm.

decision_rule.primary: A non-10000 theta may replace the incumbent only with a material and repeatable paired gain under the frozen post-MODEL-246 contract, without a material regression in normal held-out BPB, dependency strata, maximum-context behavior, numerical health, or cached/stateless parity.
decision_rule.fallback: If gain is not material and repeatable, retain theta 10000.

truth_boundary: No RoPE support result is called learned long-context capability.
No theta candidate is inferred from external convention without repository evidence.
No training is run before MODEL-246 publishes terminal context authority.
No paid compute is authorized or used.
